metadata.description: SOW (Stay On Web): Claude Code and Codex skills that make your website findable (technical SEO, AEO, GEO), compliant (privacy, cookies, GDPR/CCPA, payments, licenses, AI) and guarded (SQL injection, XSS, leaked keys, Supabase RLS, prompt injection, MCP and AI-tool config attacks, slopsquatting, known CVEs).

plugins.name: sow
plugins.description: findable: technical SEO, AEO and GEO for your codebase. Checks whether Google and AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity) can find, read and cite your site, and fixes what you approve. compliance: finds privacy, cookie consent, GDPR/CCPA, payments, AI disclosure and licensing gaps and builds the fixes you approve (not legal advice). guarded: finds the security holes AI-built apps tend to ship (SQL injection, XSS, shell injection, leaked keys, Supabase RLS, prompt injection, poisoned MCP and AI-tool configs, hidden instructions, made-up packages, known CVEs) and fixes what you approve (a code check, not a pentest). No API keys.
